blurb: Guests take helicopter flights over downtown St. Petersburg, Tampa Bay, and the Gulf Coast, enjoying aerial views of city skylines, waterfronts, beaches, and resorts. Flights are FAA-compliant, fully insured, and led by experienced pilots. Tours offer photo opportunities and a bird’s eye perspective of the region's landmarks and coastline.
extraNote: Arrive 10-15 minutes before reservation time for check-in · Reservation time is check-in time, not exact flight departure time · Late arrival over 10 minutes incurs $25 fee payable before boarding; no refund if denied boarding · Flights may be cancelled or delayed due to unsafe weather at pilot's discretion · Weather insurance available for full refund excluding insurance cost if cancelled due to weather
